messages:
alex_support: Hey team — customer tenant-acme hitting rerank endpoint with model id 'rerank-main-latest' and getting either all-zero scores or a 410 ModelDeprecated yesterday -> today. They pasted curl + payload; asking for quick escalation, they're blocked in prod. Request-id: rreq_0a1b2c3d.

alex_support: curl example:
```
curl -X POST \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rerank-main-latest","queries":["what is the refund policy"],"candidates":["policy v2","refunds are 30 days"]}'
```

alex_support: Response body they got: `{"error":"ModelDeprecated","message":"model 'reranker-legacy-v1' has been deprecated"}` or sometimes `scores: [0,0]` depending on client. Customer insists they did not change their client.

priya_support: thanks Alex — can you share the raw request-id and full request body they sent (no creds)? also which region and whether this is reranking or /search rerank flow.

alex_support: pasted full body and request-id above, region: us-west-2. It is the rerank endpoint (/v1/rerank). They only changed prompts, not model id.

carlos_sre: looking at logs for tenant-acme and request rreq_0a1b2c3d -> I see alias resolution attempted: `alias: rerank-main-latest -> model: reranker-legacy-v1` but the model record was marked deprecated and removed from active catalog on 2025-08-01. Calls now get a 410 model deprecated in the catalog layer. Log excerpt: `ERROR alias_resolver.go:123 alias=rerank-main-latest resolved_to=reranker-legacy-v1 status=deprecated`.

carlos_sre: also noticed some older client SDKs will silently fall back and produce zeros when the model returns an empty score array; we should avoid silent 200+empty-scores behaviour.

maya_prod_eng: thanks — that's our expected behavior for aliases that pointed to removed legacy models. We should do two things: 1) make alias resolution return a more helpful error message (include recommended replacement alias/model) and 2) provide a temporary alias redirect for tenant-acme to point to `rerank-v2` while we coordinate with the customer on validation. I can do (2) if support approves.

alex_support: customer wants a quick fix. Could we point rerank-main-latest -> rerank-v2 as a tenant-scoped alias override? If yes, request they validate.

maya_prod_eng: yes, we have tenant-scoped alias overrides. I'll open a short-lived mapping and rollout to the config service. Patch will include a deprecation note in the response: `ModelDeprecated: "reranker-legacy-v1" -> try "rerank-v2"` and return 410 rather than silent 200+zeros.

maya_prod_eng: creating change now, tagging for canary to us-west-2 and tenant-acme. /cc @deploy-bot to run the config rollout.

deploy-bot: triggered config-rollout 1962504335 for alias-override:rerank-main-latest -> rerank-v2 (tenant: tenant-acme). Canary in us-west-2 starting...

deploy-bot: canary complete, 5 nodes healthy. Rolling out remainder...

deploy-bot: rollout complete (1962504470).

carlos_sre: I can confirm alias table updated for tenant-acme: `rerank-main-latest -> rerank-v2`. Old alias target left in audit logs.

alex_support: pushed update to customer to retry. They just confirmed: new response shows non-zero scores and sensible ordering. :tada: Customer will run full validation suite and report back.

priya_support: great — follow-up items: 1) notify the customer about the deprecation and recommend full eval against rerank-v2, 2) ensure we ship the deprecation message change so other customers get clear guidance instead of ambiguous zeros.

maya_prod_eng: on it — I'll open two PRs: one for the alias error message + 410 semantics, and one for a monitoring rule that alerts when alias resolution returns deprecated target frequently.

alex_support: thanks all — marking resolved for tenant-acme but keeping thread open for PR review notes.

maya_prod_eng: small note for postmortem: we should avoid silently deleting model artifacts without a grace window for aliases; adding to roadmap.

carlos_sre: closing loop — logs and audit saved under incident key rerank-1962504321.

alex_support: thanks everyone! :pray:
